causes.detail: The conda package cache contained hardlinks shared with miniforge environments, so deleting /home/bgy/miniforge3/pkgs freed far less than its du-measured size.

/var/crash files are root-owned; the bgy-run checksum manifest was empty, so the pre-delete SHA256 verification for CLN-03 did not actually run. The archive remains on HDD with post-hoc root hash/size evidence and is classified CONTRACT_MISMATCH / EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.

/home/bgy/photo_timeline was root-owned; the original bgy migration script failed closed on source removal and was completed through an authorized root helper with ownership preservation and SHA256 verification.
